firm_data.firm_description: The United States Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of New York represents the United States in Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island, and Long Island. Their mission is to seek justice under the law in protecting and serving the people of this district and nation.
notable_facts: The Eastern District of New York is one of the premier U.S. Attorney’s Offices in the nation.
The office has a very active and sophisticated national security program.
The office prosecutes virtually every type of federal crime and represents the interests of the United States in civil litigation.

additional_contacts.name: John Durham
additional_contacts.title: Chief of the Long Island Division

email.subject: AI for Eastern District of New York, built for national security and white-collar work
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

The Eastern District of New York's national security and white-collar crime programs are among the most sophisticated in the nation. That level of complexity demands tools that match the stakes.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and offices across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters most: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional offices. I'd be happy to stop by Brooklyn to show how ex-lawyers like ourselves are helping similar teams compete with larger operations.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
